workflows.name: Fanvue New Subscriber Onboarding
workflows.trigger: Fanvue webhook or scheduled delta sync for subscriber.created / subscriber.updated
steps: Validate webhook signature or trusted sync source
Normalize Fanvue subscriber payload
Upsert hydra_fanvue_fans
Insert hydra_fanvue_events
Attach campaign attribution when tracking link metadata exists
Generate optional OpenAI welcome-message suggestion
Insert hydra_fanvue_approval_queue record
Notify creator in Discord or dashboard for review

workflows.name: Fanvue Daily Analytics Digest
steps: Refresh OAuth token with serialized refresh lock when needed
Fetch insights and earnings deltas
Fetch tracking-link performance
Fetch chat workload counts only where authorized
Upsert hydra_fanvue_daily_metrics
Generate AI summary with revenue, audience, workload, and campaign notes
Send report to email or Discord

workflows.name: Fanvue Chat Workload Summary
workflows.trigger: Webhook message.received / message.read, or efficient delta pull
steps: Avoid polling every chat on a fixed interval
Use webhook event or bulk delta sync when available
Summarize workload without exposing unnecessary private content
Draft reply suggestions only when creator enabled
Insert suggestions into approval queue instead of sending automatically

workflows.name: Fanvue Campaign Attribution Sync
steps: Fetch tracking links and associated metadata
Map TikTok / Instagram / X / landing-page UTM values
Upsert hydra_fanvue_campaigns
Connect Fanvue fan or revenue events to campaign IDs
Report campaign ROI and conversion trend

workflows.name: Fanvue Discord Role Sync
steps: Validate subscriber lifecycle status
Check Discord identity mapping and consent
Create approval item for role changes if required by community policy
Apply or remove Discord role
Log action to hydra_fanvue_events

standingRules: Prefer webhooks and delta sync over full polling.
Never send Fanvue messages without creator approval unless a future policy explicitly permits a narrow, disclosed, consented auto-response.
Do not store plaintext private content when a summary or pointer is sufficient.
Never log tokens, client secrets, private media URLs, or full message bodies into automation logs.
